hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The pattern consists of an odd number of elements forming a pyramid of squares: x, x^2, x^4, ..., peak, ..., x^4, x^2, x.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Special case: for number 1, any odd number of 1s forms a valid pyramid since 1^2 = 1. Max length is count(1) if odd, or count(1) - 1 if even.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For numbers x > 1, greedily extend the sequence as long as count(x) >= 2, moving to x^2 each step until count(x) == 1 (which acts as the peak).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map frequency lookup where values square each step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all subsets requires 2^n exponential exploration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle edge case for 1 and recognize logarithmic chaining depth of successive squares.
